title: Pure Gouki
summary: Pure Gouki wrestling Link-climbing and beatdown build, centering George Gore's relentless EARTH Warriors alongside generic Warrior extenders. Every Gouki monster floats into a different Gouki card upon hitting the graveyard from the field, creating perpetual hand advantage to fuel Gouki Re-Match and establish unaffected Link-4 bosses like Gouki The Powerload Ogre.

summary.title: Starters
points: Gouki Suprex Special Summons a Gouki monster from your hand upon Normal Summon, providing 2 Warrior bodies for an instant Link-2.
Gouki Machine Suprex Special Summons itself and another Gouki from hand, functioning as a starter and Tuner.
Reinforcement of the Army searches Gouki Suprex or Machine Suprex to guarantee turn 1 combo starters.
Fire Flint Lady Special Summons itself from hand while you control any Warrior monster, adding a free extender to the board.
Every Gouki monster searches a differently named Gouki card from your Deck whenever it is sent from the field to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Gouki Suprex + Any Gouki Monster
steps: Normal Summon Gouki Suprex and use its on-summon effect to Special Summon a Gouki monster (such as Twistcobra or Riscorpio) from your hand.
Link Summon Gouki Sheik Ogre (or Jet Ogre) using both Gouki monsters.
Trigger both sent Gouki monsters in the GY: search Gouki Headbatt and Gouki Re-Match from your Deck.
Discard a Gouki card to Special Summon Gouki Headbatt from your hand targeting your Link Monster.
Activate Gouki Re-Match to revive the two Gouki monsters from your GY in Defense Position.
Use the revived Gouki monsters and Headbatt to Link Summon Gouki The Powerload Ogre or Gouki The Master Ogre.

summary.title: Bosses & Finishers
points: Gouki The Powerload Ogre (Link-4) gains ATK equal to the total Link Rating of other Link Monsters x 200, is completely unaffected by other cards' effects while Link Summoned, and can tribute a Gouki Link Monster to destroy cards up to its Link Rating.
Gouki The Master Ogre (Link-4) can attack all opponent monsters once each, and returns Gouki monsters it points to back to the hand as a Quick Effect to negate face-up cards on the field.
Gouki The Tyrant Ogre (Level 8 Fusion, cheated out via Gouki Sheik Ogre) destroys cards on summon up to the Link Rating of Gouki Link materials, and prevents opponent activations in battle.
Gouki Finishing Move targets a Gouki Link Monster, boosting its ATK by 1000 per Link Rating and granting piercing damage for an instant OTK.

summary.title: Spells & Utility
points: Gouki Re-Match is the premier engine Spell: it revives 2 Gouki monsters with different Levels from your GY, turning any Link-2 into an immediate Link-4.
Gouki Face Turn destroys a Gouki card you control (such as Gouki Gameface) to revive any Gouki monster from your GY, including Link Monsters.
Gouki Octostretch and Gouki Iron Claw provide hand-trap protection and battle boosts while searching when sent from the field.
S:P Little Knight and Tri-Gate Wizard provide versatile banishment and co-link disruption.

allow.Fire Flint Lady: Level 1 FIRE Warrior that Special Summons itself while you control a Warrior to put a second Warrior on the field alongside any Gouki monster.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Gouki Suprex or Gouki Machine Suprex.
allow.Ferocious Flame Swordsman: Link-2 FIRE Warrior that boosts all Warrior monsters by 500 ATK and revives a non-Link Warrior upon destruction.
allow.S:P Little Knight: Link-2 Warrior that banishes an opposing card on summon and banishes 2 monsters until the End Phase as a Quick Effect.
allow.Tri-Gate Wizard: Link-3 co-link boss that banishes opposing cards and negates card activations.

main: Gouki Suprex
Core Level 4 starter: Special Summons 1 'Gouki' monster from your hand when Normal Summoned, and searches any Gouki card from your Deck when sent from the field to the GY.
Gouki Machine Suprex
Level 4 EARTH Warrior Tuner: Special Summons itself and another Gouki from hand, and searches any Gouki card from your Deck when sent from the field to the GY.
Gouki Headbatt
Level 2 Gouki that sends 1 other Gouki monster from your hand to the GY to Special Summon itself from your hand while you control a Gouki, and searches any Gouki card when sent from field to GY.
Gouki Twistcobra
Level 3 Gouki that tributes 1 Gouki monster as a Quick Effect to give another Gouki ATK equal to its original ATK, and searches any Gouki card when sent from field to GY.
Gouki Octostretch
Level 1 Gouki handtrap that halves battle/effect damage and searches any Gouki card when sent from the field to the GY.
Gouki Guts
Level 1 Gouki that cannot be destroyed by battle, boosts all Goukis by 200 ATK, and searches any Gouki card when sent from the field to the GY.
Gouki Iron Claw
Level 2 Gouki handtrap that discards itself during damage calculation to give your battling Gouki +1000 ATK and make it unaffected by opponent's card effects, and searches when sent from field to GY.
Gouki Riscorpio
Level 5 Gouki (2300 ATK) that can be Normal Summoned without Tributing if you control no monsters or only Goukis, and searches any Gouki card when sent from field to GY.
Fire Flint Lady
Free Level 1 Warrior extender from hand to enable a Link-2 Summon alongside any single Gouki.
Gouki Re-Match
Core Spell (searchable by any Gouki!) that Special Summons 2 Gouki monsters with different Levels from your GY in Defense Position—turning any Link-2 into a Link-4 Powerload Ogre or Master Ogre!
Gouki Gameface
Continuous Spell that protects Goukis and tributes a Link-3+ Gouki to Special Summon a Gouki from Deck or Extra Deck.
Gouki Cage Match
Continuous Spell that places counters when Gouki monsters are summoned and searches Gouki cards.
Gouki Finishing Move
Searched by Gouki GY effects; gives a Gouki Link Monster +1000 ATK per Link Rating (putting Link-4 Master Ogre or Powerload Ogre at 6800 ATK!) and piercing damage.
Gouki Face Turn
Destroys 1 Gouki card you control (like Gouki Gameface) to revive a Gouki monster from your GY (including Gouki Link Monsters!).
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Gouki Suprex or Gouki Machine Suprex.

Link-3 Gouki that reduces opposing monsters' ATK by their original DEF and protects itself from destruction.
Link-3 Gouki that grants an additional Normal Summon to a zone it points to during the Main Phase.
Link-2 Gouki that negates the activation of an opponent's monster effect that points to it and revives a Gouki.
